notes: FleetComm 1.0.1 — command's punch list, plus the helmet cam. NEW: the CAM station (04) — stream your Star Citizen POV to shipmates, watch one feed solo or several in a grid, and float any tile over the game with PIP. Peer-to-peer video, nothing new to host; borderless-window mode captures best; up to 4 watchers per cam. FIXED: nets created mid-op by another COMMAND account now appear on everyone's board within seconds, and tuning them from ATC works (this was the 'Tune failed: Invalid Username' bug). The VOL and L·R sliders now actually slide — grab a row to reorder it by the ⠿ grip only. ALSO: a radio-effect intensity slider in SYS (0 clean · 50 standard · 100 heavy, anywhere between); keybinds can be cleared to UNBOUND (while a badge is listening: BACKSPACE unbinds, ESC keeps the old key — cycle-net keys included); the 1MC no longer double-plays a local preview, what you hear is the net itself; the overlay carries a compact UTC clock; the rail's Ship's State now answers the actual question — which ships of the line are crewed right now, live headcounts per ship; the theme is plainly named Light/Dark; and FleetComm finally wears the 22nd's crest as its app icon.
